name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: Events along a rail: each node pops in turn, the line draws down to the next, and the text rises in beside it.

perf.budget: Plain views with three shared values per event, played once on mount. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Every event is in place from the start.
a11y.screenReader: Each event is one element that reads its time, title, description and whether it is happening now or coming up.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive itself; content passed as children keeps its own targets.
